summary: INLIF Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Chinese machinery maker listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting, reconvened September 15, 2026 after a September 8 adjournment for lack of quorum. Holders of 68,181 Class A and 43,908 Class B ordinary shares were represented. Shareholders approved an ordinary resolution increasing authorized share capital to US$2.72 billion divided into 8 billion Class A and 500 million Class B shares, and adopted a seventh amended memorandum and articles, with a par-value reduction from US$0.32 to US$0.0001 contemplated. No deal terms or special-situation event arise.
